review_kind: Codex (OpenAI) AI translation and review on 2026-11-19 of Qt error-message batch 6 mask loading, puncta inputs and volume editing. No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.key:
Puncta detection requires a 2-D image and matching parent mask.

Load a two-dimensional image and a parent mask with the same height and width.
records.source:
Puncta detection requires a 2-D image and matching parent mask.

Load a two-dimensional image and a parent mask with the same height and width.
records.translation:
A detecção de pontos exige uma imagem 2-D e uma máscara parental correspondente.

Carregue uma imagem bidimensional e uma máscara parental com a mesma altura e largura.

records.key:
Image and parent mask must contain finite values.

Load an image and parent mask without NaN or infinite values.
records.source:
Image and parent mask must contain finite values.

Load an image and parent mask without NaN or infinite values.
records.translation:
A imagem e a máscara parental devem conter valores finitos.

Carregue uma imagem e uma máscara parental sem NaN nem valores infinitos.

records.key:
Parent masks must contain nonnegative integer labels.

Load a labelled mask with zero for background and positive whole numbers for objects.
records.source:
Parent masks must contain nonnegative integer labels.

Load a labelled mask with zero for background and positive whole numbers for objects.
records.translation:
As máscaras parentais devem conter rótulos inteiros não negativos.

Carregue uma máscara rotulada com zero para o fundo e números inteiros positivos para os objetos.

records.key:
Invalid puncta scale, threshold, centre-pixel or spacing settings.

Enter finite values: positive scales and k, a nonnegative edge margin, 1 to 81 centre pixels, and integer spacing of at least 1 pixel.
records.source:
Invalid puncta scale, threshold, centre-pixel or spacing settings.

Enter finite values: positive scales and k, a nonnegative edge margin, 1 to 81 centre pixels, and integer spacing of at least 1 pixel.
records.translation:
Configurações inválidas de escala, limiar, pixels centrais ou espaçamento de pontos.

Insira valores finitos: escalas e k positivos, uma margem de borda não negativa, de 1 a 81 pixels centrais e um espaçamento inteiro de pelo menos 1 pixel.

records.key:
The selected image plane exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit.

Use Import to prepare a smaller image before opening it in the editor.
records.source:
The selected image plane exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit.

Use Import to prepare a smaller image before opening it in the editor.
records.translation:
O plano de imagem selecionado excede o limite de 256 MiB do editor.

Use Importar para preparar uma imagem menor antes de abri-la no editor.

records.key:
The reader returned an invalid or changed image plane.

Reopen the source and select a valid image plane.
records.source:
The reader returned an invalid or changed image plane.

Reopen the source and select a valid image plane.
records.translation:
O leitor devolveu um plano de imagem inválido ou alterado.

Abra novamente a origem e selecione um plano de imagem válido.

records.key:
The image source is not a regular file.

Select an existing image file instead of a folder or device.
records.source:
The image source is not a regular file.

Select an existing image file instead of a folder or device.
records.translation:
A origem da imagem não é um arquivo regular.

Selecione um arquivo de imagem existente em vez de uma pasta ou dispositivo.

records.key:
3D masks require a finite numeric spatial TIFF within the volume memory budget.

Open a finite numeric 3D volume with at most 16,777,216 voxels and 256 MiB of decoded data.
records.source:
3D masks require a finite numeric spatial TIFF within the volume memory budget.

Open a finite numeric 3D volume with at most 16,777,216 voxels and 256 MiB of decoded data.
records.translation:
Máscaras 3D exigem um TIFF espacial numérico finito dentro do limite de memória para volumes.

Abra um volume 3D numérico finito com no máximo 16,777,216 voxels e 256 MiB de dados decodificados.

records.key:
Voxel spacing must contain three positive finite distances.

Enter one positive spacing value for each spatial axis, in the stored axis order.
records.source:
Voxel spacing must contain three positive finite distances.

Enter one positive spacing value for each spatial axis, in the stored axis order.
records.translation:
O espaçamento de voxel deve conter três distâncias finitas positivas.

Insira um valor de espaçamento positivo para cada eixo espacial, na ordem de eixos armazenada.

records.key:
The physical image bounds must be finite.

Check the image dimensions and voxel spacing, then reopen the volume with valid physical dimensions.
records.source:
The physical image bounds must be finite.

Check the image dimensions and voxel spacing, then reopen the volume with valid physical dimensions.
records.translation:
Os limites físicos da imagem devem ser finitos.

Verifique as dimensões da imagem e o espaçamento de voxel; depois, abra novamente o volume com dimensões físicas válidas.

records.key:
The volume mask must contain matching nonnegative integer object labels up to 65535.

Load a mask with the same shape as the volume and integer labels from 0 to 65535.
records.source:
The volume mask must contain matching nonnegative integer object labels up to 65535.

Load a mask with the same shape as the volume and integer labels from 0 to 65535.
records.translation:
A máscara de volume deve conter rótulos de objeto inteiros não negativos correspondentes de até 65535.

Carregue uma máscara com a mesma forma do volume e rótulos inteiros de 0 a 65535.

records.key:
The section index lies outside the volume.

Select a section within the displayed range for the chosen axis.
records.source:
The section index lies outside the volume.

Select a section within the displayed range for the chosen axis.
records.translation:
O índice da seção está fora do volume.

Selecione uma seção dentro do intervalo exibido para o eixo escolhido.

records.key:
The drawn section does not match the volume section.

Redraw the section on the current volume plane with matching dimensions.
records.source:
The drawn section does not match the volume section.

Redraw the section on the current volume plane with matching dimensions.
records.translation:
A seção desenhada não corresponde à seção do volume.

Desenhe novamente a seção no plano atual do volume com dimensões correspondentes.

records.key:
The detected labels do not match the volume.

Run detection again on the current volume and use labels with the same dimensions.
records.source:
The detected labels do not match the volume.

Run detection again on the current volume and use labels with the same dimensions.
records.translation:
Os rótulos detectados não correspondem ao volume.

Execute novamente a detecção no volume atual e use rótulos com as mesmas dimensões.

records.key:
The edited volume overlaps another object; no labels were changed.

Move or resize the edited boundary so it does not overlap another object, then apply it again.
records.source:
The edited volume overlaps another object; no labels were changed.

Move or resize the edited boundary so it does not overlap another object, then apply it again.
records.translation:
O volume editado se sobrepõe a outro objeto; nenhum rótulo foi alterado.

Mova ou redimensione o limite editado para que não se sobreponha a outro objeto e aplique-o novamente.

records.key:
This edit exceeds the volume undo memory budget; no labels were changed.

Apply the change in smaller steps or work on a smaller volume.
records.source:
This edit exceeds the volume undo memory budget; no labels were changed.

Apply the change in smaller steps or work on a smaller volume.
records.translation:
Esta edição excede o limite de memória para desfazer em volumes; nenhum rótulo foi alterado.

Aplique a alteração em etapas menores ou trabalhe com um volume menor.

records.key:
The source volume changed while opening it.

Wait until the source file is stable, then reopen the volume.
records.source:
The source volume changed while opening it.

Wait until the source file is stable, then reopen the volume.
records.translation:
O volume de origem foi alterado durante a abertura.

Espere até que o arquivo de origem pare de mudar e abra novamente o volume.

records.key:
The source volume changed; no mask was saved.

Reload the current source volume before editing and saving its mask.
records.source:
The source volume changed; no mask was saved.

Reload the current source volume before editing and saving its mask.
records.translation:
O volume de origem foi alterado; nenhuma máscara foi salva.

Recarregue o volume de origem atual antes de editar e salvar sua máscara.

records.key:
The mask output must not overwrite the source volume.

Choose a different output file for the mask.
records.source:
The mask output must not overwrite the source volume.

Choose a different output file for the mask.
records.translation:
A saída da máscara não deve sobrescrever o volume de origem.

Escolha outro arquivo de saída para a máscara.

records.key:
This volume is already being saved.

Wait for the current save to finish before saving again.
records.source:
This volume is already being saved.

Wait for the current save to finish before saving again.
records.translation:
Este volume já está sendo salvo.

Espere o salvamento atual terminar antes de salvar novamente.

records.key:
The saved volume changed outside this session; no mask was overwritten.

Reopen the latest saved volume before making further edits.
records.source:
The saved volume changed outside this session; no mask was overwritten.

Reopen the latest saved volume before making further edits.
records.translation:
O volume salvo foi alterado fora desta sessão; nenhuma máscara foi sobrescrita.

Abra novamente a versão mais recente do volume salvo antes de fazer outras alterações.

records.key:
The volume files changed during saving; no output was replaced.

Stop other writes to these files, reopen the current volume, and save again.
records.source:
The volume files changed during saving; no output was replaced.

Stop other writes to these files, reopen the current volume, and save again.
records.translation:
Os arquivos do volume foram alterados durante o salvamento; nenhuma saída foi substituída.

Interrompa outras gravações nesses arquivos, abra novamente o volume atual e salve de novo.

records.key:
The saved volume geometry does not match these source and mask pixels.

Open the matching source, mask and geometry sidecar from the same saved volume.
records.source:
The saved volume geometry does not match these source and mask pixels.

Open the matching source, mask and geometry sidecar from the same saved volume.
records.translation:
A geometria do volume salvo não corresponde a estes pixels de origem e de máscara.

Abra a origem, a máscara e o arquivo auxiliar de geometria correspondentes ao mesmo volume salvo.

records.key:
The saved volume anchor controls are invalid.

Open a saved volume with valid anchor controls, or restore a matching backup.
records.source:
The saved volume anchor controls are invalid.

Open a saved volume with valid anchor controls, or restore a matching backup.
records.translation:
Os controles de âncoras do volume salvo são inválidos.

Abra um volume salvo com controles de âncoras válidos ou restaure uma cópia de segurança correspondente.

records.key:
The saved mask axes do not match the spatial source.

Choose the mask saved for this volume with the same spatial axis order.
records.source:
The saved mask axes do not match the spatial source.

Choose the mask saved for this volume with the same spatial axis order.
records.translation:
Os eixos da máscara salva não correspondem à origem espacial.

Escolha a máscara salva para este volume com a mesma ordem dos eixos espaciais.
